data.narrative:
Harbinger is a Series C transportation company founded by John Harris, Phillip Weicker, and Will Eberts. The broader transportation frontier-tech universe comprises 8 private peers (including Rivian, The Boring Company, Einride, Slate Auto, and ZeroAvia) with no public comparables available. Harbinger has raised $358M to date.

Valuation analysis relies on stage-progression methodology, as a narrow peer median cannot be reliably constructed. Transportation lacks sufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables meeting minimum density thresholds (n≥3) to support peer-based triangulation. The stage-progression approach applies a 1.7x multiplier to a $100M base (derived from total capital raised as a valuation proxy), yielding an implied value of $170M. This reflects typical capital-stage step-ups from Series C forward.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $144M to $195M, with a median estimate of $170M. Key uncertainties include the appropriateness of the 1.7x step-up multiplier absent transaction-level evidence in this specific subsector, reliance on total raised as a base proxy without visibility into burn or unit economics, and the absence of near-peer public benchmarks to anchor relative valuations. Refinement would benefit from additional Series C or Series D transactions in narrower transportation verticals.
